gen-audiowide-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condens: Audiowide lays its letters out like spaced tiles, with no swell or thinning anywhere in the stroke. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed carries running text smoothly, with lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height.
gen-fs-bonny-archivo: Bonny sets tight lines with a restrained swell, like a round brush barely pressed. Archivo then carries the text beneath, tall in the x-height, its curves opening outward instead of curling in.
gen-audiowide-gf-vend-sans: Wide, tiled, unmistakably techy: Audiowide draws every stroke without swell. Vend Sans, the sans-serif underneath, draws ruler-straight lines, lets its lowercase fill the line, and leaves curves unclosed at the ends.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya keeps its curve gaps generous and its small letters nearly as tall as the capitals. Noto Sans Oriya sits quietly under Eater, whose soft stroke contrast and wide gaps look dark and aggressive.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-asap: Tight-set, literary lines with gaping curves: that is Bonny. Asap brings open-arc c forms and a body height nearly matching the capitals, the sharpest contrast with Bonny's moderate lowercase.
gen-audiowide-gf-yaldevi: Audiowide never pinches its joins or swells its bowls. That makes it a futuristic display voice, while Yaldevi handles the sans text, its outsized lowercase and right-opening e staying clean.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-epilogue: Literary and refined, Bonny sets its lines tight with gaping curves. Epilogue brings curvy, unclamped letters, stubby ascender tips and a wire-like monoline skeleton, a taller lowercase than Bonny's moderate one.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-pahawh: Letters that never pinch shut give Almendra Display its ornate, literary face. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, its x-height set high, reads smoothly across long text, with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle.
gen-eater-gf-stack-sans-notch: Wide letter gaps and mild stroke contrast give Eater its dark, aggressive bite. Stack Sans Notch keeps text steady beneath, with open curves and rod-stock horizontals and verticals of identical thickness.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-phoeni: Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut, ornate and a bit literary. Noto Sans Phoenician, plain sans through and through, reads smoothly with generous lowercase height and s curves that open wide at both ends.
